notes.title: About the AI and version differences (a quick clarification)
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We’ve received a few questions about how the game works and whether it uses AI. Here's a quick clarification:

To comply with current platform policy, the Steam version of Virtual Girlfriend does not include AI-powered conversations. This is because, as of now, games marked as “adults only” are not permitted to use AI features on this platform.

That said, all other features — especially those intended for mature audiences — remain fully present in the Steam version.

If you’re looking for an alternative version of the game with AI-driven dialogue and memory, it will be available on a different platform. You can find more details on our social pages or in the discussion threads.

We respect every platform’s rules and deeply appreciate your support wherever you choose to play. 

Thanks again for your support and understanding. 

Don't forget to subscribe to the game's page on IndieDB so you don't miss anything: https://www.indiedb.com/games/virtual-girlfriend
